value.rationale: This is a natural complete sharp classification of the shift-sign subsystem at the first dimension d=35 not excluded by the motivating odd-degree number-field sieve above d=3. It reduces 21828 possible field-compatible signs to 19 in three symmetry classes, supplies exact representatives, and resolves the realizability distinction for the restricted cyclic subsystem. The count guides a finite search for the stronger modulated/field conditions without asserting any general theorem.
